label: Peplink SDX Pro
description: Modular enterprise SD-WAN router: 2 integrated GE WAN/LAN ports expanding to 18 with modules, 24 Gbps throughput. M2 / 1TB / 2TB storage SKUs.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: Ethernet WAN port **2-18 (GE)**, Number of Ethernet LAN port **0-18 (GE)**, Router Throughput **24 Gbps**. The ranges are modular capacity, not licence unlocks: **2 integrated GE WAN/LAN ports, plus up to 16 more via expansion modules**, so the port count is a build decision rather than a fixed property of the model. Only the two integrated ports are modelled here. The three requests this covers (#455, #456, #457) are the **M2, 1 TB and 2 TB storage SKUs** - identical ports and throughput, different onboard storage, which no interface list records.
